company: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre For Advanced Scientific Research
description: I joined JNCASR as a Project Assistant under Prof. Shobhana Narasimhan, where I work on first-principles simulations of nanoscale materials using VASP. In collaboration with researchers at IISER Thiruvananthapuram and a PhD researcher in the group, I am investigating the Ge/SiGe semiconductor interface to understand the formation of two-dimensional electron and hole gases at the junction. This work has strengthened my understanding of how atomic-scale variations influence emergent electronic properties relevant to next-generation device applications.
Worked on robotics-focused practical learning and prototyping as part of the internship program.

company: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre For Advanced Scientific Research
description: During my SURC internship at JNCASR, I worked with VASP to perform Density Functional Theory (DFT) simulations. My main project focused on reproducing published results for CsPbBr₃ and CsPbCl₃, ensuring consistency in structural and electronic properties. Alongside this, I explored WSe₂ systems, where I gained experience in SCF convergence, band structure calculations, density of states, and charge density analysis.
